description: Compares the timing of two incoming rhythms, giving alignment, in-between and gap triggers plus a tension voltage for how close they are

params.text: Sets how close two edges have to be to count as aligned, from an eighth of a beat up to a whole beat, and shortens the silence that counts as a gap as it is raised
Places the in-between trigger along the way from an incoming edge to the next predicted edge of the other rhythm, from 5% to 95%
Averages the distance reading over the last one to eight edges, which smooths the tension voltage
Latches, freezing the last four beats of triggers and tension and replaying them against the clock; pressing it again goes back to the incoming rhythms
Sets the span that counts as the rhythms being as far apart as possible, from a sixteenth of a beat to 2 beats

inputs.text: One of the two rhythms compared; every rising edge is timed against the other rhythm
The other of the two rhythms compared; every rising edge is timed against the first
One pulse per quarter note, the beat that distances, windows, gaps and the hold replay are measured in
A rising edge clears all measured timing and releases the hold

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 1ms long when an edge on A and an edge on B fall inside the window set by WIN
A 10V pulse 1ms long at the point between the two rhythms set by POS
A 10V pulse 1ms long when neither rhythm has produced an edge for the time set by WIN
0-10V rising as the two rhythms get closer: 10V when they land together, 0V when they are a full RNG apart

notes: ALIGN, BTW and TENS stay silent until an edge has arrived on both A and B. GAP and the hold replay also need a clock at CLK
exactly simultaneous edges fire ALIGN only every other time, and two align pulses are never closer together than a sixteenth of a beat
menu: 1 PPQN (Submit standard) — reads each pulse at CLK as one quarter note
4 PPQN (compatibility) — reads four pulses at CLK as one quarter note
